What the shop does

Haircuts and fades

Scissor cuts, buzz cuts, fades and shape ups. Customers write that the barbers take the time to understand exactly what they want.

Beards and shaves

Beard trim and shaping, beard conditioning, a clean shave and head shave.

Full grooming

Hair wash, scalp massage, eyebrows, waxing, facial and hair colouring. One customer came in for the full treatment before his wedding.

Walk-ins and kids

Appointments are recommended, walk-ins are welcome and so are kids. Reviews mention short waiting times.

Why customers come back

What customers notice on Google.

Attention to detail

Twelve reviews single out the attention to detail, from the cut to the beard and the finishing touches.

A friendly team

Friendly team is the phrase that comes up most. Customers talk football, feel at home and some come back every week.

Clean and modern

A clean, modern and well designed space, with graffiti on the walls and a honeycomb of lights on the ceiling.

In Limassol since 2021

The shop opened in 2021 on Andrea Zaimi street, in Christiana Court. A customer who has been coming since he moved to the island calls it the best barber shop in Limassol, and a visitor from abroad writes he would fly back to Cyprus just for a cut here.

What customers say

Two of 296 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

“I’m very satisfied with my visit to this barbershop! The atmosphere is stylish and cozy, and you can immediately feel the professionalism and attention to detail. The barber carefully listened to all my preferences and delivered exactly the haircut I wanted — even better. I’d also like to highlight the service: friendly staff, great communication, and a truly personalized approach. I highly recommend this place to anyone who values quality, style, and comfort. I will definitely come back again!”
